claims.text: Malaysia conditional mean government revenue loss for the first event year, constant 2025 USD, original unscaled supporting value.
Malaysia conditional mean government revenue loss for the second event year, constant 2025 USD, original unscaled supporting value.

Malaysia's cumulative two-year mean revenue loss is the sum of the two yearly conditional mean values reported above; the fixed evidence packet contains no precomputed cumulative Malaysia cell, so the cumulative total is derived by adding the two yearly means rather than read from a single cell. The yearly means are signed mean losses, distinct from the positive-part expected shortfall used for tail measures.

limitations: The packet contains no Malaysia cumulative two-year risk cell; the cumulative mean is not directly available as a single tool value.
No unit-conversion tool was available in this single-response fixed-evidence mode, so the values are retained in their original unscaled 2025 USD form rather than expressed in millions.
Historical input provenance for this assessment is incomplete; recomputable is false and the assessment is for inspection only.
The estimate is a conditional, non-causally-identified scenario difference (revenue without the event minus revenue with the event), not a total-economy loss or a sovereign default probability.

response.reasoning_content: Malaysia cumulative 2026–2027: 14,691,048.577 + 29,891,762.458 = 44,582,811.035 (approx). But no tool for sum; instructions say every numeric finding must be exact tool value with ONE evidence ID. There's no cumulative MYS cell in packet (truncated after AUS cumulative). We have year cells; can I compute sum? "Never sum country quantiles" — means are means, summing means across years is arithmetically fine but must be a tool value. Instructions: numeric claims need exact tool value. I can submit two numeric claims (2026 and 2027 means) and a descriptive interpretation noting the two-year total cannot be recomputed... Actually the user asked for cumulative mean revenue loss in millions. We could convert with convert_units—but no such tool available here; only submit_findings. So report both years in millions? Converting to millions would require dividing by 1e6 — not a tool value. Hmm. Submitting 14691048.577458847 with unit "2025 USD" — but requested millions. I can note limitation that conversion to millions is unsupported. Better: submit the two year values as-is, and an interpretation describing cumulative as sum of the two means, noting recomputation limit. But digits forbidden in prose. So numeric claims: 2026 value, 2027 value, each with one evidence ID. Then interpretation claim without digits: "The cumulative two-year mean revenue loss for Malaysia equals the sum of the yearly means; the packet contains no precomputed cumulative Malaysia cell, so the combined value is derived by addition of the two yearly means." Also metadata assessment date claim. Limitations: no cumulative Malaysia cell in packet; no unit-conversion tool to express in millions; original unscaled values retained.
